comment: DVB-S2 transport stream: BBFRAMEs in TS mode (MATYPE TS, no null packet deletion) whose data fields carry 188-byte user packets back to back across frames, cut out by SYNCD and UPL (rpps.link.packets). Each user packet's sync byte was replaced by the CRC-8 of the packet before: it is checked, and 0x47 put back, so the packets come out as MPEG transport stream packets, a message each, captured for Wireshark as MPEG-TS. Frames in another mode (GSE) are passed over; null packet deletion (NPD) is not read yet. Serial (no parallel region: the BBHEADER drives the packet step after it)
